proposed_from.topic: Solve minimax annealed causal assignment with known target-population cell masses and capacity, lambda_n=kappa/sqrt(n), and a fixed-dimensional Gaussian contact experiment. Characterize the scalar reverse-KL minimax rule, its least-favorable prior, strict plug-in risk gap, certified computation, and temperature limits. Then solve the weighted multivariate capacity problem by recursive exposed-face Gaussian experiments, proving compatible minimax maps, polynomial certified risk/map approximation, and strict separation from coordinatewise linear-logit shrinkers. Finally derive the observed-data causal LAN lower bound and an exactly capacity-feasible cross-fitted learner with estimated covariance, expanding-local attainment, and honest policy/welfare confidence sets. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Independent presolve derived the scalar posterior-Bayes identity delta(z)=expit(E[H|Z=z]/kappa), nonrandomized minimax existence, essential uniqueness, symmetry, monotonicity, strict shrinkage, and a proper least-favorable prior whose support must be locally finite, countably infinite, and unbounded in both directions. Interval calculations certify that at kappa=1 the plug-in worst risk exceeds that of expit(0.8Z) by more than 0.0141. It also derived projected Gaussian experiments on every exposed capacity face, lower bounds from face risks, and an upper bound forcing risk to vanish with residual capacity. The corrected four-arm Bernoulli path has Fisher information one, and known target masses make exact population capacity feasible. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove compatible minimax extensions across nested exposed faces, essential multivariate uniqueness, polynomial certified value and expected-KL map recovery, strict separation from every common positive scaling, and covariance-stable expanding-local causal attainment. EARLY KILL TEST: Solve the three-cell equal-mass, half-capacity problem with contact covariance diag(1,4), certify all six edge extensions, and test normal rays, tangential offsets, and near-wall directions; pivot if face limits are incompatible or the coupled optimum lies in the declared diagonal class. seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Determine whether minimax rules on all nested exposed capacity faces admit one compatible global extension.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction, pages 2--5; Theorem 1 and its limit-experiment construction; Conclusion, minimax conjecture paragraph
seed_details.m11_subshape: matched local minimax value and attainment
seed_details.summary: Characterize an essentially unique reverse-KL minimax capacity map by recursively gluing Gaussian games on every exposed face, then certify its strict advantage over common-scaling logistic rules.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace average posterior integration over the global coupling space by a worst-risk saddle whose mass can escape along normal rays, and prove a cocycle condition for the residual Bayes maps on intersections of face flags.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for Gaussian minimax capacity coupling, exposed-face minimax gluing, and entropy-regularized treatment assignment found average optimality and fixed-cost transport duality but no compatible minimax extension theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from SunadaIzumi2025 plus strict convexity of entropy.
seed_details.rebuttal: Strict convexity gives a unique oracle at each state, not uniqueness of a minimax rule on a noncompact state space; facewise solutions need not agree on nested intersections.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The focal object is the compatible global map and its gluing criterion, not a generic policy-regret restatement.
seed_details.burned_reason: Angle 0 exhausted six revisions and was explicitly given up after the second validity gate; further retry was unauthorized and switch would evade the cap.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Characterize the scalar reverse-KL minimax rule and every proper least-favorable prior.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Theorem 4.2; proof steps that guess a two-point prior, derive the logistic Bayes rule, and verify the equalizer; Conclusion
seed_details.summary: Prove posterior-mean logistic minimaxity, essential uniqueness, locally finite countably infinite least-favorable support, strict plug-in gap, and both temperature limits.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace posterior sign probability under a two-point prior by the posterior mean first-order condition under reverse KL; bounded prior support then creates divergent tail risk instead of an equalizer.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for logistic normal-mean minimaxity under Bernoulli reverse KL found nonlinear-regret and Gaussian predictive-density analogues but no exact assignment game.
seed_details.red_team: Theorem 4.2 of KitagawaLeeQiu2026 already proves a logistic Gaussian minimax rule.
seed_details.rebuttal: Its loss is mean-square regret and its rule is posterior sign probability under two support points; reverse KL uses a posterior mean and excludes every bounded-support prior.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The result supplies a complete scalar saddle but is retained as the edge engine rather than substituted for the multivariate kernel.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Attain the multivariate Gaussian value with an exactly feasible cross-fitted observational learner.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Gaussian limit-experiment lower bound and attaining-rule construction; concluding discussion
seed_details.m11_subshape: matched rate and local minimax attainment
seed_details.summary: Derive the causal LAN lower bound and an estimated-covariance rule whose normalized risk converges uniformly on explicit expanding local balls while satisfying capacity on every sample.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pointwise continuous mapping of a fixed Gaussian rule by a quantitative stability inequality uniform across normal-fan walls and estimated covariance.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining cross-fitted policy learning, exact population capacity, estimated Gaussian covariance, and expanding-local minimaxity found no matching upper theorem.
seed_details.red_team: HiranoPorter2009 plus ChernozhukovEtAl2018DML gives the result mechanically.
seed_details.rebuttal: Neither source controls discontinuous face changes of the minimax correspondence on expanding parameter sets, and DML consistency alone does not yield risk-map stability.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The lower bound and upper learner share the same realized covariance geometry and exact-capacity action space.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Characterize the semiparametric efficiency bound for the finite-cell contact contrast under capacity.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; efficient doubly robust score construction; main regret theorem; Discussion
seed_details.summary: Derive the efficient influence function for the tangent contrast and an attaining cross-fitted covariance estimator.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Project the vector of cellwise efficient scores through the known mass-weighted capacity tangent before whitening.
seed_details.destination_search: The finite-cell influence function follows standard semiparametric projection once masses are known; no distinct unresolved efficiency object remained after the Gaussian geometry was fixed.
seed_details.red_team: This is a direct linear transformation of the standard cell-effect influence function.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds; the object is setup for the LAN theorem rather than a standalone kernel.
seed_details.search_obstruction: Known finite-dimensional cell means make the efficiency calculation routine; the open content begins at minimax decision transfer.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Generated for the required efficiency lane and dropped because it is not theorem-level novelty.

seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; canonical-gradient result for resource-constrained value; threshold-randomization construction; discussion excluding positive threshold mass
seed_details.m11_subshape: nonregular limit law and uniform confidence set
seed_details.summary: Invert joint efficient-score ellipsoids through a certified set-valued face map to cover welfare and expected-KL policy neighborhoods at capacity contact.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace regular delta-method differentiation away from threshold mass by set-valued propagation through all active exposed faces, including covariance and numerical error.
seed_details.destination_search: Softmax policy-value inference and stabilized nonunique-rule inference do not impose exact capacity or cover nested face-recursive maps.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Retained as an explicit open rung of the selected proposal, not presented as an already available Wald corollary.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Obtain finite-sample coverage for a capacity-constrained policy map by symmetry inversion.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Resource-constrained stochastic-rule setup and threshold-mass discussion
seed_details.summary: Invert permutations of cellwise efficient scores to cover the capacity policy map exactly.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the asymptotic score ellipsoid by a permutation orbit that preserves the joint capacity-coupled statistic.
seed_details.destination_search: No nontrivial permutation group preserves observational treatment assignment, estimated nuisance functions, and the target capacity map without stronger randomized-design assumptions.
seed_details.red_team: Observational cross-fitted scores are not exchangeable under within-cell treatment permutations.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds in the stated observational model, so the symmetry lane is dropped rather than smuggling in a randomized experiment.
seed_details.search_obstruction: Exact finite-sample symmetry is absent from the observational sampling model; honest inference must use the local Gaussian experiment.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Generated for the required M17 lane and rejected on its identifying symmetry premise.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Certify value and expected-KL map recovery for the semi-infinite Gaussian capacity game.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Theorem 1 fast entropic-penalty rate and proof; assignment specialization; Conclusion
seed_details.summary: Give a fixed-dimensional polynomial algorithm combining face enumeration, Gaussian tail truncation, finite saddle programs, and strong-convexity map recovery.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace a finite linear objective and its energy gap by a semi-infinite adversarial Gaussian risk with face-dependent tail experiments and posterior-predictive lower certificates.
seed_details.destination_search: Sinkhorn complexity and entropic-bias papers certify finite transport objectives, not unbounded Gaussian nature states or expected-KL recovery of a minimax decision map.
seed_details.red_team: Discretize the Gaussian and invoke polynomial-time convex optimization.
seed_details.rebuttal: A compact-box discretization gives no global risk bound on tangential face experiments and a value gap alone does not imply the required uniform expected-KL map error.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Merged into the selected gluing kernel because the certificate depends on the same compatibility theorem.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Determine the zero- and high-temperature limits of reverse-KL minimax annealing.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; finite Gaussian minimax theorem; asymptotic limit-experiment section; Conclusion
seed_details.summary: Show convergence to the sign-rule minimax problem as temperature vanishes and to the admissible Gaussian mean rule after quadratic rescaling at high temperature.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace a fixed nonlinear-regret transformation by epi-convergence of the reverse-KL Bregman loss and identify the rescaled high-temperature action through the Gaussian mean experiment.
seed_details.destination_search: The searched nonlinear-regret and entropic-transport sources do not provide both decision-rule limits for an unrestricted Gaussian nature space.
seed_details.red_team: Both limits follow from a Taylor expansion of the logistic function.
seed_details.rebuttal: Pointwise oracle expansions do not identify the minimax rule; tightness, risk interchange, and uniqueness of the limiting Gaussian decision problem are necessary.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The limit law is a supporting scalar theorem and not inflated into the multivariate paper kernel.

seed_details.anchor_open_problem: Prove a positive minimax risk gap from every common positive linear-logit scaling.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; main Gaussian minimax multiplicity theorem; least-randomizing selection result; Conclusion
seed_details.summary: Reduce all finite-risk coordinatewise scalings to a common multiplier and certify a uniform positive gap on the unequal-covariance three-cell geometry.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace selection among multiple scalar randomized minimax rules by a covariance-sensitive separation of an entire parametric map class under coupled capacity.
seed_details.destination_search: No source found compares the full common-scaling logistic class to a capacity-coupled Gaussian minimax map under reverse KL.
seed_details.red_team: Curvature noncommutation already proves the logistic class is suboptimal.
seed_details.rebuttal: Curvature mismatch is only local and does not imply a positive worst-risk gap; the separation must control all multipliers, including zero and infinity limits.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Merged into the main gluing question as its falsifiable strict-delta clause.
